name: John Stuart Mill
full_name: Philosopher and Liberal MP, author of On Liberty

notes.ECO: Free trade, with growing sympathy for cooperatives and taxing inherited wealth.
notes.SOC: Argued for women's suffrage in Parliament in 1867.
notes.LIB: The harm principle: the state may only restrict what harms others.
